description: We are Team Astrological, a group of developers, designers, and researchers passionate about turning complex space science into engaging, interactive web experiences. For NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026, we are tackling the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge by building The Galactic History Museum—a mobile-first 3D web app where students step into the role of "Cosmic Archaeologists" to explore NASA’s resting hardware across the Moon, Mars, and deep space.
